title: Dale, New Mexico as a tall white playground

tellings.quote: let's say out by Dale here in New Mexico, which is one of the tall white playgrounds,

plain: The country around Dale, New Mexico is "one of the tall white playgrounds," a place where tall, pale beings he calls the Tall Whites like to spend time. So says Charles Hall, a man who says he spent three years living alongside these beings at Area 51, a secret Air Force base in Nevada, and he speaks from what he says he saw himself. If true, it would mean these beings move freely around parts of the American Southwest.
